verdict.rationale: Programmatic TOTP retrieval is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a touch-driven mobile app for viewing, editing and transferring codes. The GitHub repository's RFC 6238 generator implementations and PAM module are developer building blocks and server-side verification, not a documented CLI or API an agent can call to fetch a current code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can fetch a current TOTP code programmatically — via CLI or API — to complete a 2FA login inside an automated workflow
